summary.name: Follow-up visit scheduling and confirmation
summary.description: For medication patients, request a follow-up visit within the treatment decision interval, check for the visit order immediately, and notify the care team if no order is found.

parameters.name: follow_up_interval
parameters.description: Interval derived from the Treatment Recommendation output Follow Up Weeks.

parameters.name: visit_reason
parameters.default: Arrange the planned hypertension follow-up visit.
parameters.description: Reason supplied with the visit request.

parameters.name: notify_reason
parameters.default: No follow-up visit was found in the EHR during the expected interval.
parameters.description: Reason shown to the responsible clinician.

parameters.name: max_duration
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed for this automation.

automatability.rationale: The treatment decision routes medication patients with a two- or four-week interval to visit scheduling and an immediate order check.

process.name: Follow-up visit scheduling and confirmation
